# Native AEP binary/XML test pair

Unmodified fixtures from [EffectCraft Corpus](https://github.com/storytold/effectcraft-corpus/tree/97262276f625afdeeb61787e4cbb74b3f17af510/aep),
revision `97262276f625afdeeb61787e4cbb74b3f17af510`, by vangel76.
The MIT license option is selected. Per-file attribution and upstream notice
are retained; only the sidecars' local license-file paths were adapted.

| File | Bytes | SHA-256 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| aepx-pair.aep | 369340 | da8ba17d095ddb1576db658ad28a3966d7231244cf0391f77d71d7aa68c6e085 |
| aepx-pair.aepx | 803478 | 59e79c1621de108a4960d2bb6b14bc54e39df658f459af777b50fa95f2b7b32b |

The files were generated in After Effects 2026 and sanitized upstream, as
described in their attribution sidecars. They contain no third-party footage.
Their ICC profile stubs are metadata fixtures, not color-transform references.
The corpus regression verifies both digests before native import and compares
independent expected composition counts, source identities, text and geometry.
They are development test assets and are not shipped in the application.
